messages:
emma: Hey folks — can someone take a quick look at PR #8291? CI keeps failing on a flaky test (test_hash_consistency) but it's green locally for me. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8291

ben: I can take a look. Which job is failing?

ci-bot: Build 8291-branch — job: linux-unit-3 — failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/12345

ben: From the log it times out in hash-table test, looks like intermittent assert in test_hash_consistency. Can you paste the failure snippet?

emma: ```AssertionError: expected 0x3f2a to equal 0x3f2b
File tests/test_hash.py:42
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/test_hash.py", line 42, in test_hash_consistency
    assert computed_hash == expected_hash
AssertionError
```

emma: Happens about 1/10 runs locally. Could be timing or seeding.

theo: Can you try a rerun? might be CI noise or infra flake. I'll queue a rerun if you don't have perms.

emma: rerunning now — `/ci rerun 12345`

ci-bot: Rerun queued by emma — new build 12346. Starting jobs...

ci-bot: Build 12346/linux-unit-3 — PASSED :tada:

ben: Nice — looks like a transient. If it passes consistently, we should merge after one more approver.

priya: I'll give a quick approval if the next run stays green. Also consider adding small retry or test stabilization.

emma: thanks @priya. I'll open a tiny follow-up to add a retry decorator in the test harness.

theo: Approved from me. @ben can you merge when CI is stable?

ben: Merging now. Please watch for any rollouts. :shipit:
